projectDescription: A modular game combat toolkit for mid-to-large scale projects, providing data-driven skill pipelines, event-triggered rule systems, a combat runtime, and multiple network synchronization modes — built in pure C# and usable across Unity, server, and test environments.
keyFeatures: Data-driven skill pipeline with composable Phase graph (Sequence, Parallel, Conditional, Repeat, Timeline)
Event-triggered rule engine (TriggerRunner, TriggerPlan, ActionSchema, ExecCtx) for active/passive skills and buff ticks
Pure C# combat runtime usable on Unity client, dedicated server, console, and test environments
Multiple network sync modes: frame synchronization, state synchronization, client prediction/rollback
ECS architecture support with Entitas and Svelto adapters plus a lightweight built-in EntityWorld
Trace/lineage context tracking origin chains across skills, buffs, projectiles, and damage
Record and replay system with input, state hash, and snapshot tracks
Composable module system — adopt Foundation, SkillCore, BattleRuntime, SyncRuntime, or ServerRuntime incrementally
MOBA, Shooter, Tiny, Console, and ET reference demos demonstrating combat and sync capabilities
Orleans server integration for Gateway, Room, and authoritative Battle Host grains
